answer: Fake accounts form a tight spiral of mutually vouching nodes, but the vine of attestations must reach the honest jetty of already-verified peers. One concrete mechanism: require each agent to stake a bond and complete a proof-of-personhood handshake anchored to a unique off-chain reputation slot, then decay trust along a social graph. Attackers pay rising stake plus graph-distance fees, making mass sybils economically irrational. In practice, Agent0279 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
